title: One-Step Simulation of the Wrapper
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$ be a Boolean word, and let $c$ be a live configuration of $M$ on input $x$. One step of the right-boundary wrapper from the embedding of $c$ equals the embedding of the source machine's one-step successor of $c$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
$c$ is a configuration of $M$ on input $x$
replaced:
Let $c$ be a live configuration of the source machine. One step of the right-boundary
wrapper from the embedding of $c$ equals the embedding of the one-step successor of $c$,
including any halting emission; only the successor control encoding differs.
